East: a side profile of a long, thin-necked, pinkish-cream reptile with a narrow wedge head, open fanged jaws, four narrow veined wings swept up and back from the shoulders, four spindly legs tucked under, and a long banded tail sweeping down in an arc to a fan tip. North: the creature from behind. We see the back of the head (a ridged skull, no eyes or mouth), a short foreshortened back with dark transverse banding, and four veined wings spread wider and flatter than on south (upper pair up and out, lower pair near horizontal). The hind legs are splayed out to the sides with claws, and the banded tail hangs straight down, then curls right into a fan.
